rows.label: tlk70000066_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey, what kind of treasure d'you think
I should look for next? There are so
many places I want to visit...

rows.label: tlk70000066_04_msg0002
rows.name:
After all, Alst still has plenty of
legends and traditions that remain
unexplained...

rows.label: tlk70000066_04_msg0003
rows.name:
I'd love to visit even a place like
"Eden" if I could.

rows.label: tlk70000066_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I couldn't climb the World Tree, so
it's only a dream. But as an
adventurer, I can't stop wondering.

rows.label: tlk70000066_04_msg0005
rows.name:
There has to be treasure even more
amazing than gold sleeping there!
